name: THE UNDERTAKER
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the table's middle, clear of him at its right end (errata 86 C).
note: THE UNDERTAKER, never named (doc 27 note 2), at the viewing table -- the room's one working surface (doc 26) -- planing pine. Doc 27's examine layer is his only description: 'A man in his fifties in a clean apron, doing something careful with a plane' (errata 86 B). Drawn first in room-13's composition master beside Thad, then alone on magenta in five poses against a side-by-side with Thad (room-13 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room13-undertaker.py. BEHIND THE TABLE: the sheet stops at the table top, so `y` is the cut row, not his feet. Present in every act.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the undertaker.
